title: Sensex options swing sharply as 74,800 call jumps 340% during auction
text: Sensex options swing sharply as 74,800 call jumps 340% during auction. Sharp price swings in expiring contracts have renewed concerns over India’s derivatives settlement system and the mismatch between cash and options markets
